key.name: city
key.description: City name for weather data (e.g., 'Berlin' or 'New York')

key.name: use-celsius
key.description: If true, displays temperature in Celsius; otherwise uses Fahrenheit

key.name: update-interval-minutes
key.description: How often to fetch new weather data (minimum 5, maximum 120 minutes)

key.name: openweather-api-key
key.description: API key for OpenWeather provider (required for OpenWeather)

key.name: tomorrow-api-key
key.description: API key for Tomorrow.io provider (required for Tomorrow.io)
